assets.prompt: Top-down orthographic terrain art of a PLANET SURFACE, portrait framing, the entire frame is the ground plane seen straight down. Terrain: cracked desaturated teal basalt plain with wind-eroded flat rock shelves, fine gravel, shallow dry channels, a few small impact craters, subtle weathered hexagonal survey etching, thin frost-like white mineral veins. ONE single continuous glowing cyan energy route, about 6 percent of the frame width: it enters at the TOP edge at the horizontal center, runs straight DOWN, sweeps out into a WIDE FULL CIRCLE loop that occupies the middle of the frame, comes back to the center line, then runs straight down and terminates at the BOTTOM edge at the exact horizontal center in a wide empty circular landing basin with a low flat rim. The route is a flat compacted lane with bright cyan emissive edge strips and short white dash markings, casting a soft cyan glow on the rock. Cel-shaded anime style: flat two-tone shading, hard-edged shadows, bold dark outlines on all terrain edges, NO gradients. Very dark low-contrast ground so small glowing units read clearly on top. NO buildings, NO structures, NO towers, NO turrets, NO gates, NO portals, NO arches, NO standing crystals, NO characters, NO vehicles, NO text, NO UI, NO icons, NO arrows, NO labels. Pure planet terrain and one glowing route only.
